business_summary: Saipem is an Italy-listed (Euronext Milan: SPM) offshore engineering, construction and drilling contractor. It built and installed the Neptun Deep offshore platform, the fixed Black Sea installation this whole chain is anchored on, manufacturing both the jacket and topsides and using its own Saipem 7000 crane vessel for installation.

exposure_summary.narrative: Saipem's sole offshore-counter-drone placement is platform-integration-and-hardening (CROWDED, impact 40/crowdedness 72), which the chain's own bottleneck note labels ARCH-002, 'volume without capture': competitively bid offshore construction whose scope is set by the operator, using scarce crane-vessel capacity inside a low-margin contracting model. No revenue is disclosed broken out for counter-drone hardening specifically versus Saipem's much larger offshore construction and drilling backlog.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: no revenue percentage tied to counter-drone platform hardening specifically is sourced for Saipem this run; the Neptun Deep contract itself was for platform construction and installation, not counter-drone systems integration. See data_gaps.

latest_fy.basis: Fiscal-year revenue for the period ended 2025-12-31: 15,504,000,000 EUR from the yfinance-statements statements in SPM-MI.json.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Compound annual revenue growth computed as (15,504,000,000/9,987,000,000)**(1/3.0007)-1 from the yfinance-statements revenue series, period ended 2022-12-31 to period ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 691,000,000 EUR divided by revenue 15,504,000,000 EUR, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series: a thin margin consistent with the chain's own note that this is competitively bid, low-margin contracting.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 1,504,000,000 EUR divided by net income 310,000,000 EUR, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 1,504,000,000 EUR less capex 364,000,000 EUR, divided by revenue 15,504,000,000 EUR, all for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 2,212,000,000 EUR (total debt 3,106,000,000 less cash 894,000,000, as of 2025-12-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 1,679,000,000 EUR (operating income 691,000,000 plus depreciation 988,000,000, period ended 2025-12-31), from the yfinance-statements series.

piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 7 (state STRONG) computed over yfinance-statements statements in SPM-MI.json quality.piotroski, 9 of 9 inputs found.

beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score PENDING_DATA in SPM-MI.json quality.beneish: missing sga_fy input (11 of 12 inputs found); not computable this run.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 8,686,645,639 EUR computed in SPM-MI.json quality.derived.market_cap from vendor/official share count and price (method section 6A vendor-aggregate fundamentals).

price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 8,686,645,639 EUR divided by revenue 15,504,000,000 EUR for the period ended 2025-12-31.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 10,898,645,639 EUR implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 1,140,000,000 EUR, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth over yfinance-statements statements. The solve is negative: the market is pricing FCF decline from this base. Assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon (5y -8.64%, 7y -6.14%, 10y -4.26%). Measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a price statement; the sign (decline priced in) is stable across all three horizons.

crowdedness_caveats: Saipem's sole offshore-counter-drone link (platform-integration-and-hardening) is CROWDED (impact 40/crowdedness 72); the chain's own bottleneck note names this ARCH-002, 'volume without capture', a trap named rather than implied: the work is real and the crane vessels are few, but the capture ceiling on competitively bid construction work is low.

risks.claim: Altman Z-score is 1.80 (DISTRESS zone) despite the STRONG Piotroski read, a genuine tension between short-term operating discipline and balance-sheet solvency risk that this profile cannot resolve from the vendor block alone; net debt/EBITDA is a moderate 1.32x on a thin 4.46% operating margin.
